units.source_text: 她沉默良久才转过身去，背向我们前走来的方向折了回去。

en.t: After a long silence, she finally turned around and went back, heading away from the direction from which we had come.
I helped Kashiwagi to his feet.

units.source_text: 扶起之前，他的身子显得非常沉重，他痛苦地喘着粗气。

en.t: Before I lifted him, his body seemed terribly heavy, and he was gasping painfully for breath.

units.source_text: 可是，扶着我的肩膀行走时，他的身体却意外地轻盈了……

en.t: Yet when he walked with his hand on my shoulder, his body became unexpectedly light...
